title: KONICA FAXR
description: DIRECT ACCOUNTS AND CHAINS HEADQUARTERED OUTSIDE THE REGION

pre_sfi.ayas_clae: PRE-SELL: Obviously, even pre-sell campaign was not effective – most accounts received what they ordered.
pre_sfi.harley_transition: HARLEY TRANSITION BOOKLET/COUPON: The booklet/coupon was fantastic. It alerted the consumer to the upcoming change over – because of the coupon, consumers anxiously anticipated the arrival of Mavericks – they were definitely ready to come twice coupons!
pre_sfi.arrtig_asa: MAVERICK/HARLEY BIG1F: This was an extremely effective program. It changed the perception of cells and gave our introductory gift packs on Mavericks.
pre_sfi.c_qsas: Somewhat enabled us to produce our sales as full visual facing ran out while we still had Mavericks in sights package on the distribution warehouse.
